hook: asperity 是刺耳語氣，aspersion 是潑髒水——同一個「asp-」開頭，一個扎耳朵，一個髒衣服。
script: asperity＝嚴厲／粗暴。aspersion＝誹謗中傷（cast aspersions）。護士提醒：語氣刺≠名聲髒。

members.senseAnchor: something hard to endure; harshness of manner
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 刺耳針: asperity walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「刺耳針」出場：asperity 一上場梗就黏住——嚴厲粗暴。

related.synonyms: grimness, hardship, rigor, rigour, severity, severeness
